changelog.change: PostalLoads should now support all old versions of Postal 2!
Added full support for Corkscrew Rules and Eternal Damnation.
The autoupdate should work now! No more manually deleting files!
Added full support for Apocalypse Weekend and Paradise Lost.
Simplified settings screen. All game specific settings are now handled automatically.
Added a new setting (Week Runs) to allow for A Week In Paradise and Two Weeks In Paradise runs even if auto reset is activated.
Added auto starting for ILs runs on Postal 2.
